recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. If future review identifies a TestScript expression/path mismatch, update HL7/fhir-testing-ig or its published package source rather than reintroducing inactive core TestScript source.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU2-era FHIR-core TestScript request to add FHIRPath support for TestScript.variable.path, TestScript.setup.action.assert.path, and TestScript.setup.action.assert.compareToSourcePath by adding parallel expression elements while retaining the path elements for compatibility.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 10002, mirrored in git as 8c7627b26e26e23cb06ce3f4c1fbcc6892ab23d7, which updated source/testscript/testscript-spreadsheet.xml with TestScript.variable.expression, TestScript.setup.action.assert.compareToSourceExpression, TestScript.setup.action.assert.expression, and related invariant changes.
additional_context: Current core no longer owns TestScript: source/fhir.ini lists the HL7 FHIR Testing IG as an additional IG and has no active testscript=TestScript resource entry; f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 removed source/testscript from core. The current FHIRPath page links TestScript assertion expressions to the Testing IG, and the Testing IG package contains the requested expression/path elements with comments expecting text/fhirpath support. Later related audits FHIR-12142 and FHIR-38716 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. The requested support was historically applied, but any future authoritative TestScript changes belong in the HL7 FHIR Testing IG rather than this FHIR-core checkout.

related_jiras.note: Related TestScript constraint tracker already audited on the combined branch with the same current Testing IG ownership finding.
Later TestScript expression guidance/link correction already represented on the combined branch; it explains the current core FHIRPath page link to the Testing IG.
